data.text: A Song of Ascents. How blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, Who walks in His ways.
When you shall eat of the fruit of the labor of your hands, How blessed will you be and how well will it be for you.
Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine In the innermost parts of your house, Your children like olive plants All around your table.
Behold, for thus shall the man be blessed Who fears Yahweh.
May Yahweh bless you from Zion, That you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
Indeed, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
